item.title: One Piece Characters Turned Into Dogs for Irritated Ruffment Figures
item.dc:creator: Jenni Lada
item.description: The Bandai Namco Big Irritated Ruffment figure line depicts One Piece characters as angry dogs.
item.content:encoded:
Bandai Namco announced a new Big Irritated Ruffment line of dog figures that depicts characters from One Piece as annoyed and upset dogs. They follow the existing Nyan Piece cat figures in the company’s MegaHouse line of kitten merchandise. The six figures will be available randomly in Gashapon capsule machines in the US and Canada in November 2026. As these will be larger than usual items, they will likely cost more than usual.

This line of toys features five Straw Hat characters from One Piece. Each one is in a different pose, most lying down. They’re all around three inches long. In each case, the pirate puppy has fur colors and accessories designed to resemble people we know. 

Here’s the list of who we can randomly get. Since there’s no “rare,” it’s a straightforward 1:5 chance of getting each style.

  • Angry Chopper Dog – “CAN’T HIDE!” style
  • Angry Franky Dog – “Ow!!” style
  • Angry Luffy Dog – “FEED ME!” style
  • Angry Nami Dog – “IT’S MINE!” style
  • Angry Usopp Dog – Taking Off Wristband style

This is how all five of the One Piece Big Irritated Ruffment figures of the various Straw Hat crew members as dogs will look.

The One Piece Big Irritated Ruffment figures of Straw Hat Pirate characters as disgruntled dogs will show up in North American Gashapon capsule machines in November 2026. You can find the One Piece anime on services like Crunchyroll and Netflix, the manga via Viz Media, the live-action adaptation on Netflix, and the Lego animated special on Netflix.

item.title: Target Black Friday 2026 Ad Highlights Switch 2 and PS5 Game Sales
item.dc:creator: Jenni Lada
item.description: The Target Black Friday 2026 ad is live and shows Switch 2 and PS5 games, some controllers, and a Meta Quest S3 offer.
item.content:encoded:
The Target Black Friday 2026 ad is live on the official site and features a number of sales on Switch 2 and PS5 games and accessories like controllers. It also kicks off the flyer with a reminder of the Switch 2 Black Friday 2026 bundle that gives people the system and copy of Mario Kart World for $499.99 instead of $549.99. (That’s universal and everywhere.) While the store will be closed on Thanksgiving Day, it will open at 6am local time in the US on November 27, 2026 again. 

In terms of possible game deals, here are the Switch 2 and PS5 titles that showed up on sale in the Target Black Friday 2026 ad. In cases where they are multiplatform, it is possible that price will apply to every version. 

  • Bluey’s Happy Snaps (Switch 2) – $39.99.
  • Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (PS5) – $59.99.
  • College Football 27 (PS5) – $34.99.
  • Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2) – $49.99.
  • FC27 (PS5) – $34.99.
  • Helldivers 2 (PS5) – $29.99.
  • It Takes Two (Switch 2) – $29.99.
  • Just Dance: Decades of Hits (Switch 2) – $29.99.
  • Kirby Air Riders (Switch 2) – $49.99.
  • Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight (Switch 2) – $49.99.
  • Lego Harry Potter Collection (Switch 2) – $34.99.
  • Madden 27 (PS5) – $34.99.
  • MLB The Show 26 (PS5) – $19.99.
  • Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls (PS5) – $39.99.
  • Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 (PS5) – $29.99.
  • Marvel’s Wolverine (PS5) – $49.99.
  • NBA 2K27 (PS5) – $29.99.
  • Star Wars Zero Company (PS5) – $44.99.
  • Super Mario Galaxy 1 & 2 (Switch) – $49.99.
  • Super Mario Party Jamboree (Switch 2) – $39.99.
  • Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest Feral Edition (Switch 2) – $29.99.
  • WWE 2K26 (PS5) – $24.99.

As for the accessory deals, here are some of the most notable and affordable controller price drops for the Switch 2 and PS5.

  • DualSense PS5 controller – $64.99.
  • DualSense Edge PS5 controller – $169.99.
  • Nova Pink DualSense for PS5 – $54.99.
  • Pulse Elite PS5 headset or earbuds – $129.99.
  • Switch 2 controller and case bundles – $69.99.

Aside from the Switch 2 Black Friday 2026 bundle with game, there is also a Meta Quest S3 sale at Target this season. It will be $297.49 for the VR headset, and people will get a $50 gift card for the store with it. The normal price is $49.99.

The Target Black Friday 2026 ad is live now and sales on Switch 2 and PS5 games and accessories may start as soon as November 22, 2026.

item.title: Christmas Fluffy Puffy Hello Kitty and Pochacco Figures Dress Like Santa
item.dc:creator: Jenni Lada
item.description: The new Banpresto Christmas Sanrio Fluffy Puffy figures dress up both Hello Kitty and Pochacco in Santa costumes.
item.content:encoded:
Bandai Namco announced its Banpresto Fluffy Puffy line will soon consist of Hello Kitty and Pochacco figures of the two Sanrio characters dressed in Santa style Christmas outfits. They’ll first launch in Japan as prize figures on November 25, 2026. They will appear via the Amazon Banpresto storefront like other mascots from the company after that for $27 each. However, the pre-order pages there state both of them will arrive after Christmas in the US and show up on March 19, 2027.

The hallmark feature of the Fluffy Puffy line is that these are relatively small, flocked figures. Each one is only about three and a half inches tall. (That can vary depending on if the character is standing up or lying down.) Each release tends to consist of A and B versions that could involve different characters or the same one in posed in two ways. In this case, we have a blushing Hello Kitty in a red dress with white trim and her red bow, with hearts along the edges for one of the two. The other is Pochacco dressed as Santa Claus and holding a gift. When displayed together, it can look like he’s giving the present to her.

Here are the initial photos showing off both characters.

These Fluffy Puffy figures aren’t the only pieces of Hello Kitty and Pochacco merchandise appearing around Christmas 2026. Both of them are part of the 2026 Build-a-Bear plush lineup for the winter holidays. Those aren’t in Santa or Christmas-themed outfits though, as instead they feature a blue and white “frosted” color scheme.

The Banpresto Fluffy Puffy Sanrio Santa version figures of Hello Kitty and Pochacco in Christmas outfits will debut in Japan on November 25, 2026. Both will appear as prizes. The official Bandai Namco Amazon storefront says they’ll both launch in the US on March 19, 2027.
